# Vendored front-end assets

Local copies so the app works without internet access. Update by downloading the same files from these sources.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `jquery-3.7.1.min.js` | https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js | MIT |
| `dataTables-2.0.8.min.js` | https://cdn.datatables.net/2.0.8/js/dataTables.min.js | MIT |
| `dataTables-2.0.8.min.css` | https://cdn.datatables.net/2.0.8/css/dataTables.dataTables.min.css | MIT |
| `fonts/space-grotesk-*.woff2` | Google Fonts, Space Grotesk (latin, latin-ext subsets) | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/OFL-SpaceGrotesk.txt` |
| `fonts/source-sans-3-*.woff2` | Google Fonts, Source Sans 3 (latin, latin-ext subsets) | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/OFL-SourceSans3.txt` |

`fonts/fonts.css` declares the font faces with the unicode ranges Google Fonts uses for each subset.
